limits: A model-specific documentation association is not proof of a downloadable/binary-distinct firmware package.
Repeated document IDs can cover multiple release/subrelease filters.
Family labels with no model-specific document are not assigned to either router.
Source spellings/irregular labels are retained without silently normalizing them.
No product IMAGEVERSION, package hash or URL is inferred from a BBD label.
